summary: Polyrizon Ltd., a development-stage biotech company, filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing successful results from its NASARIX Allergy Blocker nasal spray biocompatibility program. The program evaluated biological safety endpoints (cytotoxicity, sensitization, irritation, pyrogenicity, acute systemic toxicity) under ISO 10993 standards. No deal terms are involved. The filing is a routine operational update on clinical progress, not a special situation. Investors should monitor upcoming first-in-human trial milestones.
